title: 第一卷 第15章 白狐 他给的实在太多了第一卷 第16章 你想让我送死
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 曹阳捏着丹药，气极反笑，“这是我的东西，你在命令我？”
白狐根本不搭理曹阳的质问，四肢一发力，竟然想要抢曹阳手中的丹药！
“真当我是软柿子了？”
曹阳冷哼一声，不闪不避，右手探出一把捏住了白狐的后颈皮，将其提溜了起来。
白狐大惊失色，瞳孔猛缩。
它怎么也没想到，眼前这个底层杂役，出手竟然快到这种地步！
“放开我！”
白狐张开满是尖锐獠牙的小嘴，狠狠咬向曹阳的手腕。
与此同时，它身后的两条尾巴猛然扫动，一股粉色的妖气瞬间弥漫开来，直扑曹阳的面门。
狐族天赋。
魅惑！
只要吸入一丝，就算是同阶修士也会瞬间陷入幻境，任其宰割。
“还敢玩阴的？”
曹阳心底冷笑。
他现在的灵魂强度已经跨入四人魂，更是拥有净元之体。
这种程度的魅惑妖气，对他来说简直就像是微风拂面，连让他眨一下眼睛的资格都没有。
“真是惯的你。”曹阳抬手，狠狠地在她脑门上探了一个脑瓜崩。
“嗷呜！”
白狐被打得惨叫一声，眼冒金星，想要咬曹阳的牙齿也落空了。
直到这一刻，它才彻底清醒过来。
那粉红色的魅惑妖气对眼前这个人类毫无作用。
这小子竟然还扮猪吃虎！
曹阳懒得废话，直接将白狐按在地板上。
手掌压在白狐背上，任凭它如何挣扎都动弹不得分毫。
看着这只灵性十足双尾白狐，曹阳脑海中忽然闪过一个念头。
若是能给这妖修种下奴印收服在身边，以后能办一些见不得光的事情了。
可就在这个收服的念头刚刚升起的瞬间，曹阳的心头毫无征兆地涌起一股极其强烈的心悸感。
那是一种面对生死危机时才有的本能直觉！
仿佛这只看起来只有炼气三层的白狐背后，牵扯着某种极大的因果。
一旦真正将其收为奴仆，便会引来无穷无尽的麻烦和杀身之祸。
曹阳眉头深深皱起。
他向来相信自己的直觉，但眼前这只被他单手按在地上摩擦的狐狸，怎么看也不像是什么大能转世。
错觉？
曹阳压下心头的不安，手上微微加了一分力道。
“你也不想被宗门的执法队抓去扒皮抽筋吧？”
曹阳居高临下地看着它，“那就老实点，别乱动。”
到了这个时候，白狐终于怕了，停止了挣扎。
曹阳见它老实了，语气稍微温和了些。
content_en:
Cao Yang pinched the pill and laughed angrily, "This is my thing, are you ordering me?"
The white fox ignored Cao Yang's questioning and tried to grab the elixir in Cao Yang's hand with all his strength!
"Do you really think I'm a soft persimmon?"
Cao Yang snorted coldly, without evading, he stretched out his right hand and pinched the back of the white fox's neck, and lifted it up.
The white fox turned pale with fright, and his pupils shrank sharply.
It never expected that the low-level handyman in front of it would take action so quickly!
"Let me go!"
The white fox opened its small mouth full of sharp fangs and bit Cao Yang's wrist hard.
At the same time, the two tails behind it swept suddenly, and a pink demonic aura instantly filled the air and rushed directly to Cao Yang's face.
Fox talent.
Charming!
As long as a trace is inhaled, even monks of the same level will instantly fall into an illusion and let it be slaughtered.
"You still dare to play dirty?"
Cao Yang sneered in his heart.
His current soul strength has reached the level of a four-person soul, and he even has a pure body.
This level of charming and demonic energy was like a breeze blowing on his face, and it didn't even make him blink.
"I'm so used to you." Cao Yang raised his hand and struck her head hard.
"Ouch!"
The white fox was beaten so hard that it screamed, eyes flashed with stars, and it tried to bite Cao Yang but failed.
It wasn't until this moment that it fully woke up.
The pink charming demonic energy had no effect on the human being in front of him.
This guy actually pretended to be a pig and ate the tiger!
Cao Yang was too lazy to talk nonsense and directly pressed Bai Hu to the floor.
The palm of his hand pressed against the white fox's back, and no matter how hard it struggled, it could not move at all.
Looking at this spiritual two-tailed white fox, an idea suddenly flashed through Cao Yang's mind.
If you can plant a slave mark on this demon cultivator and keep him under control, you can do some shady things in the future.
But just when the idea of ​​​​conquering had just arisen, Cao Yang felt an extremely strong palpitation in his heart without warning.
That's an instinctive intuition that comes only when faced with a life-and-death crisis!
It seems that there is some huge cause and effect behind this white fox that seems to only have the third level of Qi Refining.
Once he is truly taken as a slave, it will cause endless trouble and death.
Cao Yang frowned deeply.
He always trusted his instincts, but the fox he was pressing on the ground and rubbing with one hand did not look like the reincarnation of a powerful person.
illusion?
Cao Yang suppressed the anxiety in his heart and put a little more force on his hands.
"You don't want to be picked up by the sect's law enforcement team and have your skin cramped, right?"
Cao Yang looked at it condescendingly, "Then be honest and don't move."
At this time, the white fox finally became afraid and stopped struggling.
Seeing that it was becoming more honest, Cao Yang's tone became a little gentler.
